sources.snippet: The idea: give an AI agent a small but real LLM training setup and let it experiment autonomously overnight. It modifies the code, trains for 5 minutes, checks if the result improved, keeps or discards, and repeats. You wake up in the morning to a log of experiments and (hopefully) a better model.

sources.title: New Ghostcommit Attack Hides Malicious Prompts in Images to Exploit AI ...
